import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import build_hierarchy


class BuildHierarchyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(build_hierarchy([]), [])

    def test_order_shape_and_metadata_independence(self):
        rows = [
            {"id": "r1", "parent_id": None, "label": "Root 1", "metadata": {"nested": [1]}, "ignored": True},
            {"id": "c1", "parent_id": "r1", "label": "Child 1", "metadata": {"x": {"y": 2}}},
            {"id": "r2", "parent_id": None, "label": "Root 2", "metadata": {}},
            {"id": "c2", "parent_id": "r1", "label": "Child 2", "metadata": {}},
            {"id": "g1", "parent_id": "c1", "label": "Grandchild", "metadata": {"items": [3]}},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(rows)
        result = build_hierarchy(rows)
        self.assertEqual([node["id"] for node in result], ["r1", "r2"])
        self.assertEqual([node["id"] for node in result[0]["children"]], ["c1", "c2"])
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["children"][0]["children"][0]["id"], "g1")
        self.assertEqual(set(result[0]), {"id", "label", "metadata", "children"})
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)
        rows[0]["metadata"]["nested"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["metadata"]["nested"], [1])
        result[0]["children"][0]["metadata"]["x"]["y"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(rows[1]["metadata"]["x"]["y"], 2)

    def test_container_type_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_hierarchy(())
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_hierarchy([[]])

    def test_malformed_rows(self):
        base = {"id": "x", "parent_id": None, "label": "X", "metadata": {}}
        for key in base:
            bad = dict(base)
            del bad[key]
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build_hierarchy([bad])
        for field, value in (("id", ""), ("id", 1), ("parent_id", 2), ("label", None), ("metadata", [])):
            bad = dict(base)
            bad[field] = value
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build_hierarchy([bad])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_hierarchy([base, dict(base)])

    def test_missing_parent_self_parent_and_long_cycle(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_hierarchy([{"id": "x", "parent_id": "missing", "label": "X", "metadata": {}}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_hierarchy([{"id": "x", "parent_id": "x", "label": "X", "metadata": {}}])
        cycle = [
            {"id": "a", "parent_id": "c", "label": "A", "metadata": {}},
            {"id": "b", "parent_id": "a", "label": "B", "metadata": {}},
            {"id": "c", "parent_id": "b", "label": "C", "metadata": {}},
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_hierarchy(cycle)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
